changeinfo.changes:
• Added new netcode options
  • Host's language now shows on Multiplayer Search Results
  • New selection menu for Rankings
  • Added "Top" and "Me" to Rankings view
  • Now makes a sound when someone joins your hosted room
  • Support touch screen
  • Cosmetic UI fixes
  • Adjusted game margins
  • Added ability to Clear control mappings under Controls Options
  • Scrolling through menus now wraps

• Game could become unresponsive due to system messages interrupting game play
  • When Player 2 wins an online game, it is now tallied under the correct character.
  • Fixed problem in "wins" board that would limit it to near 127 wins.
  • Fixed occasional problem joining a match if you summoned Help first
  • Stopped game from occasionally starting instead of showing attract mode at launch
  • Improvements in error messaging
  • Stopped in-progress saves from interfering with online multiplayer sessions or viewing of rankings
  • Fixed typos
  • "Connection Lost" could appear while screen is faded.
  • Improve input lag for local and online play
  • Updated Japanese translation of Akari's Akarineiri moves
  • Fixed issues when switching between ad hoc and online play

• Fixed freeze in burning stage
  • Fixed heat ripple effect in burning stage
  • Added option to turn off Flicker Filter
  • Allow Vs. to change Mask Mode from Game Options temporarily
  • Allow ○ button to be used to Continue
  • Fixed typo in move list

• Correct trophy requirements
  • Now pauses online game at the end of match while menu is up
  • Text fixes
